description.en: The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device belongs.

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为50。

> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Queries per second (QPS) limit

The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account calling this API is 50.

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot query-device-provisioning --product-key a1ji00000 --device-name testDevcieBwT3Un --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
